Exact perimeter/area losses are u_i=x_i+y_i-d_i and v_i=xy sin(theta_i)/2. With z=d/(x+y)>=sin(theta_i/2), the local sharp ratio v_i/u_i²>=kappa_i=sin(theta_i)/[8(1-sin(theta_i/2))²] holds, with balanced cuts x_i=y_i. The displayed algebraic local slack and weighted variance identity sum to exact DeltaA-C(K)DeltaP². Weighted Cauchy gives C=(sum 1/kappa_i)^(-1); small common t yields feasible positive equality on every side. Boundary zero cuts checked by continuity/convention. Independently verified 1000 random local exact slack identities (5 angles, 200 pairs each), distinct from full universal corner geometric proof.

Exact attained optimal constant, full nontrivial equality configurations, and a two-mechanism stability decomposition are useful structural facts; this is not a generic area monotonicity or a known-table recomputation.
residual_risks: No claim for missed sides, curved boundaries, higher-dimensional analogues or global uniform constant across polygons.
